_doc: DATUM gateway builds the site recommends, best first. This file is the only place the order lives: server.py orders the 'Which DATUM gateway' list (index.html items with data-gw=ID; their copy is connect.<i18n> in static/i18n/*.js), writes the llms.txt section, and serves the file at /api/gateway-builds for the MCP. reco marks the first entry Recommended. summary is the English line llms.txt and the MCP use. Order set 2026-10-09: FlyTheElephant first by Mike's decision; CONVOY second because its master gives every miner the whole split (the '~17 miners' line was wrong for ac9b70c) and carries fixes the others lack. Evidence: ~/xbt-rnd/xbt-133/results (CONVOY 971af86 vs b9ea7dc) and ~/xbt-rnd/gw-review/results (FTE 280cf54, iohzrd 76d748e), same harness; XBT-084 (C builds, late split) and XBT-082 (Ratum). The pool-only window after a new block and the late-split case are from XBT-084.

gateways.name: FlyTheElephant datum_gateway
gateways.summary: Master 280cf54 (7 Oct 2026): CONVOY's BLAKE2b code plus FlyTheElephant's own work; every miner gets the whole split, fitted to block weight and sigops. Regtest 9 Oct 2026 against our Prime, 60 miners in the window: blocks found by an Antminer A3 and by a generic miner each paid all 60. Like every C build, a pool-only job for ~20 ms after each new block and while the pool's split is late; lazarus/patches/datum-gateway-fte-late-coinbaser.patch removes that and still applies to master. No StartOS package; source build or its Dockerfile.

gateways.name: CONVOY datum_gateway
gateways.summary: Master 971af86 (9 Oct 2026). Firmware size classes are gone since 4d0a045 (6 Sep 2026): every miner gets the whole split, fitted to block weight and sigops. Regtest 9 Oct 2026 against our Prime, 60 miners in the window: blocks found by an Antminer A3 and by a generic miner each paid all 60. The older b9ea7dc paid 18 from a generic miner and only the pool from an A3, so update a build older than 6 Sep. Master has fixes the other C builds lack, among them e190597 (miners handed a pool-only coinbase although the split had arrived), 695d035 and d8ff316. Same ~20 ms pool-only job after each new block and while the pool's split is late.

gateways.name: iohzrd datum_gateway
gateways.summary: Master 76d748e (5 Sep 2026); StartOS pow_0.4.1_23 ships 7491a50. Every miner gets the whole split, fitted to block weight and sigops. Regtest 9 Oct 2026 against our Prime, 60 miners in the window: blocks found by an Antminer A3 and by a generic miner each paid all 60. Its two own commits are now in CONVOY master and it has not changed since, so it lacks CONVOY's later fixes. The one with a StartOS package. Same ~20 ms pool-only job after each new block and while the pool's split is late.

gateways.name: Ratum (ratum-gateway)
gateways.summary: iohzrd's Rust gateway: one binary for Linux, macOS and Windows, reading the C gateway's config file. Tested on regtest against our Prime on releases 0.1.28, 0.1.39, 0.1.53, master 0.1.54 and the B2Pool and P2Block forks: every found block booked split with every payee paid, and pool-only full work at most 0.006% of the time. Defect on every release: when the pool drops it keeps serving unpooled work, paying mining.pool_address, for 12-26 s before it disconnects miners, so set pool_address to your own address.
